At first, I thought Nynaeve was rather boring. always as stuborn as a mule and never admitting she was wrong. It's ok if you do that sometimes but... not constantly. But I did say at first. I am know reading LoC (for the first time, so no spoilers please!), and I've started to love her personality. 

Rand changed...really fast. At first he was an uncertain boy, nervewrecked when he talked to Egweyne in the first book. Now in Lord of Chaos, he is almost unrecognisable... He is one of my favourites, though.

Mat I thought was a bit whiny, but know he's one of my favourites. No change that...he is my favourite! 

I thought Elayne rather nice until she and Nynaeve go to Ebou Dar. There she acts a trifle to annoying for my taste. The way she apoke towards Mat made my quite angry.

Of course, I've only read a few of the books, and I'm sure I'll come to love them all.
